## Research experience

**Doctoral research** (Prof. Shuichi Murakami), Sept. 2023–Sept. 2026

- Magnetoelastic coupling of surface acoustic waves and magnetostatic waves in ferromagnetic films mediated by dipolar interactions.
- Quantized spin photovoltaic effects in altermagnetic Weyl semimetals.
- Diverging shift-current responses in the two-dimensional Weyl-semimetal limit.
- Emergent-gravity Hall effects from quantum geometry (with Prof. Takehito Yokoyama).

**Master's research** (Prof. Shuichi Murakami), Apr. 2022–Sept. 2023

- Polarization jumps across two-dimensional Weyl-semimetal phases (with Tiantian Zhang).
- Polarization jumps at topological phase transitions.

**Undergraduate research** (Prof. Shuichi Murakami), Apr. 2021–Mar. 2022

- Interface states in BC~2~N sheets.

**Undergraduate research** (Prof. Kazutaka Takahashi), Aug. 2020–Feb. 2022

- Dynamical Lee–Yang zeros in stochastic systems.
